context: Fix the compliance_class half first: pass the benchmark instance, or its compliance_class, into both DataFrame builders so they carry what result_factory already carries. Guard it the way tests/integration/test_tpcds_official_end_to_end.py guards the SQL path -- through the production construction path, ending at publish_admission, with the DataFrame path as a second parametrisation rather than a separate test. Then determine separately whether DataFrame validation exists at all: if it does, wire it; if it does not, that is a scoped feature and needs its own decision, not a silent not_run.
description:
MEASURED 2026-08-23 on develop, by running the same benchmark down both paths.

DataFrame path: `benchbox run --platform polars-df --benchmark tpcds --scale 0.01` emits a bundle whose benchmark block has keys id, name, scale_factor, test_type only. compliance_class is not null -- it is ABSENT -- and summary.validation is `not_run`.

SQL path, same benchmark and scale: benchmark.compliance_class is `unofficial_subscale`.

ROOT CAUSE. Two DataFrame result builders construct BenchmarkInfoInput without compliance_class:
  - benchbox/core/runner/dataframe_runner.py:232-239
  - benchbox/platforms/dataframe/benchmark_mixin.py:287-294
The SQL path builds through benchbox/core/results/result_factory.py:174, which passes compliance_class=getattr(benchmark, 'compliance_class', None). The two DataFrame builders also construct from benchmark_config rather than the benchmark instance, so they never see the classifier's output at all -- threading official through the config, as PR #1770 did, cannot reach them.

WHY IT MATTERS. benchbox submit refuses a TPC-DS bundle whose compliance_class is in CLI_REFUSED_COMPLIANCE_CLASSES, and publish_admission independently refuses any bundle whose validation_status is non-clean -- not_run is in NON_CLEAN_VALIDATION_STATUSES. So a DataFrame result is refused twice over and can never be published, no matter what the user passes. polars-df completes 309/309 TPC-DS queries and still cannot be submitted. Roughly half the corpus is DataFrame-mode.

The two halves are separable and the second is the harder one: setting compliance_class is a small fix, whereas 'DataFrame mode runs no validation' may be a real gap in the DataFrame path rather than a wiring mistake. Establish which before promising a fix.

Split out of add-third-benchmark-cohort-to-corpus w9.

anti_patterns.dont: conclude a capability is missing without searching the tracker for prior work
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD grep the tracker and the tree for the capability before asserting its absence
anti_patterns.why: I reported that no DataFrame correctness oracle existed when benchmark-cross-surface-equivalence-gate (PR #891) had built one and ~20 related items were already done, and separately claimed seven benchmarks had no DataFrame query source when all seven ship a registered dataframe_queries package

anti_patterns.dont: let a benchmark run return an empty result set as if it succeeded
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD raise, and check any 'return []' on a result path against what the CALLER does with it
anti_patterns.why: _execute_dataframe_queries returned [] when discovery found nothing, the caller marked power_test COMPLETED, and 60 bundles reporting 0/0 queries with exit 0 reached the public corpus

anti_patterns.dont: trust an existing test that asserts the current behaviour is correct
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD when a fix breaks a test, read what the test was actually asserting before assuming the fix is wrong
anti_patterns.why: tests/unit/core/runner/test_dataframe_runner_lifecycle.py::test_empty_query_list_returns_empty pinned the defect, so the 0/0-queries bug had a green test defending it

prior_art.concept: SQL is the live reference for its own DataFrame surface; no hand-maintained answer keys
existing SQL row-count oracle and skip semantics
60 of 107 DataFrame bundles carry no per-query data

verifications.command: uv run -- benchbox run --official --platform polars-df --benchmark tpcds --scale 1
verifications.description: A DataFrame TPC-DS run is classified

work_units.evidence:
MEASURED on develop 2026-08-23 across all 207 corpus bundles, splitting by platform.config.execution_mode.

Corpus-wide: 82 clean (40%), 65 with failed queries (31%, all validation=partial), 60 with NO per-query data at all (29%).

By execution mode -- the split is absolute:
  no_queries    : dataframe 60, sql 0
  failed_queries: dataframe 29, sql 36
  clean         : dataframe 18, sql 64

So every one of the 60 no-query bundles is DataFrame-mode, across all three DataFrame platforms (DataFusion 21, Polars 21, PySpark 18). Only 18 of 107 DataFrame bundles are clean (17%), against 64 of 100 SQL bundles (64%).

That places the no-query class inside this item rather than in general corpus triage: the DataFrame result path is not recording per-query data, which is the same construction path (dataframe_runner.py:232 / benchmark_mixin.py:287) that omits compliance_class. Tracked as new w5/w6.

Confirms w0's premise: those two builders are the DataFrame result construction sites, and both defects live there.
work_units.summary: Confirm both builders are the only DataFrame result construction sites

work_units.evidence: PR #1866. dataframe_compliance_class() added and wired into both builders (dataframe_runner.py:232 and benchmark_mixin.py:288). Prefers the benchmark instance, which has already run the classifier, and falls back to classifying from the config so a caller passing no instance still gets a truthful value. Emits the plain wire string: str() on the enum yields 'TpcdsComplianceClass.OFFICIAL', not 'official', which the submit and admission gates would refuse just as surely as an absent field while looking correct in a diff. Verified end to end: polars-df TPC-DS at SF0.01 now emits compliance_class 'unofficial_subscale', matching the SQL path exactly; before, the field was absent from the benchmark block entirely.
work_units.summary: Carry compliance_class into both DataFrame builders

work_units.evidence: PR #1866. tests/integration/test_tpcds_official_end_to_end.py extended from 5 to 11 tests: the DataFrame path is asserted to classify identically to the SQL path across all four cases (official SF1, unofficial SF1, subscale 0.5, nonstandard 2.0), a bundle built the DataFrame way passes publish_admission, and the enum-vs-wire-format trap is pinned explicitly.
work_units.summary: Extend the TPC-DS official end-to-end guard to cover the DataFrame path

work_units.evidence:
ANSWERED: DataFrame mode runs no validation, and 'not_run' is HONEST rather than a bug.

Both DataFrame builders set validation_status only on failure. On success they leave the ResultBuilder default 'PASSED'. _finalize_validation_metadata (benchbox/core/runner/runner.py:242) then downgrades an unevidenced PASSED to NOT_RUN -- 'current_status == PASSED and not has_validation_evidence' -- so the system deliberately refuses to claim a pass that nothing verified. That is correct behaviour and should not be changed.

CONSEQUENCE, and it is structural: publish_admission treats not_run as non-clean, so fixing compliance_class (w1) is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT. Verified directly:
  official + not_run -> allowed=False, code=non_clean, reason=validation_status=not_run
  official + passed  -> allowed=True
So every DataFrame result remains unpublishable until validation actually runs, whatever its compliance class.

The remaining question is a FEATURE question, not a defect: the SQL path validates query output against TPC answer sets, and no DataFrame equivalent is wired -- there is no answer-set comparison anywhere under benchbox/core/dataframe/ or benchbox/platforms/dataframe/. Building one is a substantial piece of work, not a fix, so it goes to w4 as a decision rather than being started unilaterally.
work_units.summary: Establish whether DataFrame mode can validate at all, or whether not_run is honest

work_units.evidence: Decision: build validation incrementally, starting with the existing TPC expected-row-count oracle only where parameters and scale are provably aligned. TPC-H SF1 with qgen-default/reference seed can produce PASSED; TPC-DS, unsupported scales/seeds/modes, missing oracles, and generic benchmarks stay UNCERTAIN or NOT_RUN. The enforced cross-surface framework remains the later full-value provider; it is not run implicitly because it requires a second execution environment.
work_units.summary: DECISION GATE - if DataFrame validation does not exist, decide whether to build it or to state plainly that DataFrame results are unpublishable

work_units.evidence:
ROOT CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED, PR #1866. _get_queries_for_benchmark dispatches to handlers for tpch/tpcds/clickbench and otherwise falls back to benchmark.get_dataframe_queries(); seven families have neither, so discovery returned [] and both builders logged a warning, returned an empty list, marked power_test COMPLETED, and emitted a bundle reporting 0/0 queries with exit 0.

Measured on develop: the split by execution mode is absolute (60 DataFrame, 0 SQL) and clean by benchmark -- amplab, coffeeshop, h2odb, nyctaxi, ssb, tpch_skew and tsbs_devops have no query data in ANY bundle; the other nine families have it in all of theirs.

NOT historical. Reproduced live on current develop: 'benchbox run --platform polars-df --benchmark ssb --scale 0.01' exited 0 with {failed 0, passed 0, total 0}. After the fix, exit 1 with a message naming the benchmark and pointing at SQL mode. tpch and tpcds on polars-df still pass, so working families are unaffected.

Note for reviewers: an existing test, test_empty_query_list_returns_empty, asserted results == [] for this path -- it was pinning the defect rather than the behaviour, and now asserts the raise.
work_units.summary: Root-cause why 60 DataFrame bundles record no per-query data at all (summary.queries.total is 0 or absent)

work_units.evidence: Decision: withdraw rather than regenerate. The 60 historical no-query DataFrame bundles contain no per-query evidence and cannot be repaired retrospectively. The develop corpus-policy PR #1880 removes the invalid cohort from the trusted inventory; published-results PR #1882 withdraws 77 bundle+manifest pairs cohort-safely, including this class. Both remain open pending protected review/merge.
work_units.summary: Decide whether the 60 no-query bundles can be regenerated or should be withdrawn from the public corpus

work_units.evidence: PR #1886 (commit 6cb3e8b14) wires both DataFrame builders to the existing TPC expected-row-count oracle with fail-closed, schema-2.2 per-query evidence. A fresh live Polars DataFrame TPC-H SF1 load+power run emitted 66/66 PASSED measurement evidence rows, reloaded all 66, passed the standalone public submission validator with 0 errors/0 warnings, and publish_admission returned allowed=True. TPC-DS and unsupported scale/seed/mode contexts remain honestly UNCERTAIN or NOT_RUN by the approved incremental decision; they are not represented as validated.
work_units.summary: Wire the DataFrame run path to record a real validation_status using the existing cross-surface oracle or the tpch/tpcds expected results
